claims.title: Directed-looking hysterons: symmetrization, energy descent and physical limits

quoted_fields.interface: Small-angle pair mapping J_ij=g_ij*k_ij*C*d_j/k_i with positive spans and symmetric pair stiffness/sign geometry. The introduced asynchronous threshold model uses fixed drive, known offsets/spans and positive symmetrizing weights.
quoted_fields.failure: Finite-angle, nonpairwise, state-dependent or hidden-coordinate mechanisms can escape this restricted map. A failed quadratic-energy representation is not proof of impossible physical input/output behavior. Formal model work is not measured mechanical joules; finite diagnostics do not qualify thermal noise, material life or timing.
